items.exampleZh: 老师做了一个关于动物的演示。

items.exampleZh: 他们喜欢在周末放风筝。

items.exampleZh: 我们今天早上进行了拔河比赛。

items.example: He can skip rope.
She is skipping to music.
The cat jumped over the fence.
They are jumping in the pool.
He can hop on one foot.
The rabbit is hopping away.
items.exampleZh: 兔子正蹦蹦跳跳地跑开。

groups.sourceText: Here is a man. / Here comes a bus. / Here comes our party.

items.example: Here is a man.
Here comes a bus.
Here comes our party.

items.example: The meeting is on the fourth of September.
The party is on September fourth (4th)
items.exampleZh: 聚会在九月的四日举行。

items.example: It is time for lunch. There are many people in the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 现在是吃午饭的时间。厨房里有许多人。

items.example: There will be.
There are all kinds of fruits in the market.
items.exampleZh: 这些市场上有各种水果。

items.example: They play football on the sports field.
items.exampleZh: 他们在运动场上踢足球。

items.example: Many others joined us in the game.
items.exampleZh: 许多人加入了我们的游戏。

items.example: After playing..., we went home.
She put a stamp on the letter.
He got a prize for his drawing.
items.exampleZh: 他因为画得好看得了奖。

items.example: There are straight trees in the park.
items.exampleZh: 这些公园里有笔直的树。

items.example: He is an excellent student.
Let me show you my new book.
items.exampleZh: 让我给你看看我的新书。

items.example: I want another one, please.
items.exampleZh: 我想要一个，再来一个吧。

items.example: He is very clever.
The car moves so fast.
I used all my strength to lift it.
items.exampleZh: 我用尽了我所有的力气把它举起来。

items.example: We are in the team now.
items.exampleZh: 我们现在已经在队里了。

items.example: We train every day.
items.exampleZh: 这项是我们每天训练的。

items.example: They are being trained now.
Math is hard for me.
As the head of the class, I am responsible for everything.
items.exampleZh: 作为班长，我对一切负责。

items.example: You must keep up with me in running.
items.exampleZh: 你必须和我保持同样的跑步速度。

items.exampleZh: 我们保持相同的速度前进。

We are good partners.

items.exampleZh: 成功的关键是努力工作。
